name: sidenote
description: Read, search and edit your Sidenote notepads with your sync key.
long_description: Sidenote is a notes app in Chrome's side panel. This extension lets Claude list, search, read, create and edit your synced notepads, tick off to-dos, and star or archive notepads. It runs on your computer: notes are decrypted here, and the sync service only ever sees encrypted data. Nothing is deleted through it.

sync_key.title: Sidenote sync key
sync_key.description: In Sidenote: Settings → Sync & devices → Show. It starts with sync-.

read_only.title: Read only
read_only.description: Only read and search; never change notes.

tools.name: list_notepads
tools.description: List notepads as a tree with ids and previews

tools.name: update_notepad
tools.description: Rename, recolour, replace, append or prepend content

tools.name: edit_notepad
tools.description: Find and replace text in a notepad
